source_match: Every recorded source input matches the isolated worktrees.
changes: DeCCP clearing authorities use independently generated Ed25519 and ML-DSA-65 keys through the common hybrid signer. Every signature binds the complete enrolled authority set, member identity, key ID/generation, authority epoch and statement under the Governance purpose.

Participant admission, margin updates, cycle opening/closing, guarantee facility registration and default decisions require the hybrid quorum. New execution checks key validity and revocation at the caller-supplied authoritative time. Cycle opening no longer accepts a request-selected clock.
Snapshot restoration verifies archived hybrid integrity against an independently trusted authority set. Restoration does not extend key validity for subsequent operations.

The actual Aethel application host carries the expanded approval and key records. RPC normalization preserves opaque cryptographic registry identifiers, including 64-character hexadecimal spellings, and decodes both signature components.

Negative tests cover missing/corrupt components, stale epoch/digest/key generation, duplicate and insufficient signers, classical-only suite, expired/revoked keys, repeated PQ material, wrong purpose, omitted wire metadata and operation replay. Rejected execution preserves the complete clearing snapshot.

verification.checks: All-target warnings-denied Clippy and full release tests for DeCCP and Aethel; formatting.
verification.evidence_limits: Deterministic cryptographic and state-machine tests, including the actual Aethel host transaction dispatcher. Core port fixtures are explicit test boundaries; no external DeFMI deployment, consensus, WAN or performance acceptance is claimed.

remaining: P4 is incomplete. The outer DeFMI governance trust anchor, participant/provider and receipt signatures, CSD/guarantor authority, cross-domain finality and operator rotation propagation still require migration.
DeCCP authority replacement and rotation operations are not yet exposed; the key metadata and immutable authority digest prevent silent key substitution within an epoch.

P1 note/opening confidentiality, TLS certificate authentication and WAN measurement; P2 reserve compatibility paths; P3 encrypted holder custody and legacy KYB; P5 hash-based public audit proofs and P6 retirement/recovery remain open.
FROST, Pedersen binding and anonymous/nullifier proofs remain classical. No full post-quantum system claim, ledger deletion, push, main merge or deployment.
